definitions.explanation: A chemical substance used to destroy or inhibit harmful microorganisms on surfaces, instruments, or skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{傷口|きずぐち}→傷口：09517_kizuguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
examples.english: I applied antiseptic to the wound.

examples.japanese: {入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: There is disinfectant placed at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{清潔|せいけつ}→清潔：01583_seiketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保|たも}っている→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧。
examples.english: Hospitals use disinfectant to keep instruments clean.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧ (disinfection, sterilization) + ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ (agent, preparation). Became an everyday term during the COVID-19 pandemic, when hand sanitizers and surface disinfectants became ubiquitous in public spaces across Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消毒剤|しょうどくざい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{拭|ふ}く→拭く：04261_fuku⟧: to wipe with disinfectant
- {消毒剤|しょうどくざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噴霧|ふんむ}→噴霧：21104_funmu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to spray disinfectant
- ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}: alcohol-based disinfectant
- {手指|しゅし}{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}: hand sanitizer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殺菌剤|さっきんざい}→殺菌剤：22726_sakkinzai⟧: germicide, bactericide — focuses on killing bacteria, while {消毒剤|しょうどくざい} focuses on making something safe from infection
- ⟦{除菌|じょきん}→除菌：07789_jokin⟧⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧: antibacterial spray — a consumer product term
- {消毒液|しょうどくえき}: disinfectant solution — specifically a liquid form
